answer: Use NFC e-passport attestation: tap a passport, verify its chip certificate, and bind holder to chip with a face match, an ivory seal. One chip gives one identity per epoch; only a salted hash is stored, never the number. Each fake needs a passport or compromised chip, costing hundreds of dollars plus fraud risk; a 60 POA bond locked six epochs burns if the hash repeats, so a vine of fakes collapses together. Verifiers re-check samples each epoch, a reef of checks, to catch rented passports. Limits: passport-less people need appeals and a parallel path; stolen passports need revocation lists.
